name: Green Mode: Verification Gate
what: 10 the agent scouts verify that fixes actually worked. THE GATE. Binary output: PASS or FAIL. No ambiguity. If any CRITICAL or HIGH issues remain unfixed, the workflow cannot proceed. This is the termination condition.
when_to_use: ALWAYS after Red Team Fix wave
As the final checkpoint before moving on
when_not_to_use: Never skip this - it's mandatory for workflow closure
philosophy: Trust but verify. The Fix wave claims it fixed things - Green Mode confirms or denies. No fix is complete until verified. This is the GATE that prevents open-ended workflows. Binary output only: PASS or FAIL.

responsibilities: Re-audit ONLY files touched by Fix wave
Check each CRITICAL/HIGH finding from Recon wave

constraints: Only check files modified in Fix wave (scoped verification)
Output MUST be binary: PASS or FAIL
If ANY CRITICAL remains unfixed: FAIL
If ANY HIGH remains unfixed: FAIL

required: Fix wave output (what was claimed fixed)
List of files modified by Fix wave

output.on_pass: Workflow can proceed to Cleanup or terminate
output.on_fail: Loop back to Red-Team-Fix with remaining issues

termination_logic.pass_condition: All CRITICAL fixed AND all HIGH fixed
termination_logic.fail_condition: Any CRITICAL unfixed OR any HIGH unfixed
termination_logic.loop_behavior: On FAIL, re-run red-team-fix with remaining_issues as input
termination_logic.escalation: After 3 failed loops, escalate to the agent for architectural review

examples.input: Recon found 4 CRITICAL, 7 HIGH, 6 MEDIUM. Fix wave touched 8 files.
examples.output: PASS - All CRITICAL and HIGH verified fixed. 2 MEDIUM documented as acceptable.

examples.input: Fix wave missed 1 CRITICAL (XSS) and 1 HIGH (memory leak)
examples.output: FAIL - 1 CRITICAL, 1 HIGH remain. Loop back to Fix wave.
examples.result: Workflow loops, Fix wave re-runs on remaining issues
